user.title: Set up water monitoring
user.description: Add the first zone and tank. Switch bindings are saved for reference only; this integration does not operate them.

data_description.level_sensor: Choose a sensor that reports depth in m, cm, or mm. Unregistered sensors are tracked only by entity ID, so replacing one with another unregistered sensor at the same ID cannot be detected.

error.invalid_switch: Select a switch entity or leave this field empty.
error.own_level_sensor: Choose a source sensor, not a level sensor created by this integration.
error.level_source_changed: The sensor at this entity ID changed while the form was open. Review the selection. To use the replacement at the previous entity ID, reopen this form and select it again.

abort.already_configured: The water controller is already configured. Use Configure to manage its inventory.

add_zone.title: Add a zone and its first tank
add_zone.description: Switch bindings are optional and are not operated by this integration.

save_tank.title: Tank settings
save_tank.description: Selection: {target}. Switch bindings are references unless you explicitly commission manual control. Stop both outputs before editing. Only one tank can be commissioned.

data.confirm_device_cutoff: I verified exclusive outputs and an independent device cutoff for each enabled role

data_description.level_sensor: Registered sensors are followed when renamed. Refill requires an unshared registered level sensor reporting m, cm, or mm.
data_description.confirm_device_cutoff: Verify the physical mapping and ensure no other controller uses the same output. Each enabled device must fail OFF independently of Home Assistant and the network. This checkbox does not test hardware. Leave both roles disabled if you cannot verify these conditions.

save_thresholds.title: Read-only threshold previews
save_thresholds.description: Selection: {target}. Fill in both fields of each feature you want to use, or leave both blank to turn that feature off. These previews never operate switches or send notifications.

confirm_remove.title: Confirm removal
confirm_remove.description: Remove {target}? Removing a zone also removes all its tanks from this integration. Source sensors and switches are not changed.

error.invalid_switch: Select a switch entity or leave this field empty.
error.own_level_sensor: Choose a source sensor, not a level sensor created by this integration.
error.confirm_required: Turn on the confirmation to remove this selection.
error.one_manual_tank: Decommission the other tank before commissioning this tank.
error.cutoff_required: Verify the exclusive physical mapping and independent device cutoff before enabling control.
error.registered_output_required: Select an enabled, registered switch. Known virtual or grouped switches cannot be used.
error.registered_source_required: Refill requires an enabled, registered level sensor.
error.shared_source: The level source is already referenced by another tank. Verify the physical mapping first.
error.shared_output: This output or device is referenced by another role. Verify and resolve the shared mapping first.
error.output_source_changed: The switch at this entity ID changed. Reopen the form and explicitly select the intended switch.
error.whole_seconds_required: Enter a whole number of seconds.
error.threshold_pair_required: Enter both fields for this feature, or clear both to disable it.
error.threshold_order: The stop threshold must be higher than the refill threshold.
error.positive_whole_delay: Enter a whole number of seconds, at least 1.
error.level_source_changed: The sensor at this entity ID changed while the form was open. Review the selection. To use the replacement at the previous entity ID, reopen this form and select it again.

abort.configuration_changed: The configuration changed while this form was open. Open Configure again and retry.
abort.manual_outputs_unsettled: Stop manual controls and wait for OFF feedback and any outstanding commands before editing.
abort.invalid_target: The selected zone or tank does not exist.
abort.minimum_zones: The controller must contain at least one zone.
abort.minimum_tanks: Each zone must contain at least one tank. To remove the whole zone, use Remove zone.
